This caused two months worth of missed payments. The app does not allow for text messages to alert you if there is an issue with payment, or if payment was processed successfully (a feature which most companies today regularly offer). I am setting up an automatic payment again, but due to the unreliability of the app, I am forced to verify through an agent on the Toyota Financial Services Customer service line that the app/account are correct this time. I also had to setup email/text alerts through customer service. The app, in my opinion, needs a thorough overhaul, or it is designed this way intentionally by Toyota and its subsidiaries to cause unnecessary/unwarranted fees to accrue for profit.

reviews.author: mi_ang_guy
reviews.review_title: Do NOT Make Changes In App
reviews.review_text: Fine app for viewing your account information, but if you need to make any changes, recommend using the website. I changed my banking information for my recurring payment in the app and ended up having money pulled from both the new account and the old account in the same month. So I was charged twice and one of the charges went to the institution I had just moved most of my funds out of. Luckily I still had enough funds in that savings account to transfer over and cover the charge. I logged into the TFS website to check my account info and the website only had my old bank info and didn’t even show the new account even though I could see that account in the app. If you make any changes, you probably want to double check both the app and the website so you don’t get multiple charges.

reviews.author: Frustrated to make payment
reviews.review_text: I have used Toyota’s previous mobile app for over a year with my new Toyota 4Runner. Then you went and changed the mobile app. With this new software upgrade it is incredibly difficult to make a payment since you can not toggle the submit payment since the toggle is below the screen. You are unable to adjust the view, the iPhone 11pro I have will rotate the screen off or raise the screen to delete activity. I tried to call in to your technical support about this issue and there is a 45 minute wait. This is not even worth dealing with since your IT individual’s clearly do not test there application before launching.

reviews.author: camper7318
reviews.review_text: This app and Toyota financial services in general is absolutely awful….they have double charged me and instead of crediting back the money through the app the have to mail me a check like it’s 1955 which is completely insane. Luckily my mailbox is at a horrible location and constantly gets stolen so after waiting the 10 days I call and they can’t do anything for me so I’m out 550 dollars that I don’t have right before Christmas. Then I have them cancel the check and just pay my December bill with that money since I won’t get the check. They said sure and I left it there but today I find out they never paid my December bill so now I’m late in my December bill. This has been awful I hate this app and I hate Toyota financial services and i have nothing by negative things to say about them….luckily I love the car but who cares when I can’t pay for it and yes I’m still out 550 dollars.

reviews.author: Boneless_Brownie
reviews.review_title: “Error, Something is wrong on our end”!
reviews.review_text: I’ve had the app for two months now. The first month, it was working perfectly fine. However, the past couple of weeks I’ve been trying to login to my account. I’ve tried resetting my password, I’ve tried re-downloading the app, and the app is up-to-date. My login info and everything is correct. But every time I try to login, I get a pop-up message saying “Looks like theirs an error on our end. Please try again soon.” There was an update yesterday and I fully updated the app. Still, I get the same pop-up message. I even tried logging in on the computer and it just freezes. Not sure what’s going on but you guys keep saying that you keep updating the app for bug fixes. I can’t get mine to work at all. I like the app because it’s very convenient, I like that I can pay my payments through the app. But it’s a little pointless if I can’t login.

reviews.author: Polo Vidas
reviews.review_text: First off, they take forever to take the money out of your bank account, even after it says that the payment was successful on the toyota app. it’s hard not to feel like this was purposefully put in place to get people to accidentally spend money that should have already been taken out of your account, because then your transaction will cancel due to insufficient funds and they get to make money for late payments, interest, etc. Second, the buttons are horrible and you have to tap multiple times to exit out of tabs and pop ups. this app is just terrible and i’ve done my fair share of digging and i found that many people are fed up as well. i don’t know if toyota directly runs this app or if there’s a partnered third party but either way they need to fix up because this is people’s money that they’re playing with. Just about ready to file a lawsuit

reviews.author: flightisfun01
reviews.review_text: TFS does currently offer the best interest rates on new Toyotas, but I guess you get what you pay for. I generally pay by phone, but their phone system rarely works. The app is glitchy and hard to navigate, so I usually end up making my payments through the Toyota app when the phone service is down. TFS also took 7 months to get me the paperwork I needed to prove I owned the Tacoma I bought so I could get it registered, and that took countless phone calls and promises that they were going to mail me the copy of my title (which never arrived even though I called them every month for several months). Eventually they had to forward me onto the customer resolution people when I told them I needed them to send me my documents and I wasn’t going to take no for an answer for the 7th month in a row. While I absolutely love my Tacoma, financing with TFS has been nothing but headaches.

reviews.author: trippy the ninja
reviews.review_title: Great update if you want to find another way to make your car payment...
reviews.review_text: This app worked fine for the past 18 months or so since I got my TFS loan. I downloaded the most recent update and the app is now a brick. It does nothing but spin and eventually tell me that they are experiencing technical difficulties and to try again later. This has been going on for three days now, and deleting the app, restarting my phone and reinstalling does not remedy the problem. This is a simple app - connect to account, pay bill, logout. Rinse, wash, repeat 30 days later. This is not rocket science - I am baffled why app developers have to get cute and mess with apps that just work and make them unusable. Way to go, fellas.

reviews.author: Hot girl 2+4=💜
reviews.review_title: SCREW TFS!!! AVOID AT ALL COSTS
reviews.review_text: I would give this app no stars if I could. Every single time I have gone in to make a payment or change payment dates it never works and it says to come back later. I have been charged twice a month for the last three months because I can’t cancel or change the date my payment comes out. And when I have called TFS customer service I have gotten hung up on and told that I have to eat the cost of all my overdraft fees because their app has bug issues. Even when the app has showed it worked on my end and scheduled a payment or cancelled a scheduled payment (for some reason even though i never agreed to automatic payments- i just go in each month and pay. it’s always still scheduled for the day it’s due) and I have the screenshots to prove it was cancelled. They weren’t cancelled and I was still charged. Never using this app again to make a payment. Screw TFS!!!!

reviews.author: 1verde
reviews.review_text: Update: 1-5-22. Toyota please change the interface back to the way it was before. I love Toyota! The July ‘21, version of the app not so much. The previous version was flawless! The main problems I have with the update is the calendar for the reoccurring section. It doesn’t have full access. The second thing is the app doesn’t fit the whole screen. I have a new phone and it worked just fine last month. I opened and closed the app several times with the same results. It’s probably just a bug and will be fixed soon. That’s beside the point. LOL! Once these two things are fixed, I’ll update from 4/5 to 5/5 stars. TOYOTA STRONG!

reviews.author: Trisha 16
reviews.review_text: Hi! The app would not let me login bc my password did not meet your new requirements. It didn’t let me login and update. I had to say I was having trouble. Stupid plan. Then the app would not let me see all the dates on the calendar to schedule a recurring payment. I have no idea why I could only pick the first week of each month. Stupid. Finally, all of my bank information was erased. You should have people that can do better then this. Also, the updated picture of the car I am paying off is the wrong color. I am not even sure if your update has me paying off the correct car. Please fix this.

reviews.author: BTRyland
reviews.review_text: This is by far the worst Financial Website I have ever encountered. The website freezes up constantly and I have to close it out and start over every time it freezes. It took me six times to set up a single monthly payment today and every month I make a payment, it freezes up multiple times before I can actually make a payment. Toyota has absolutely failed in customer service, besides failing to give me my second key fob for my car after payment and waiting six months to receive it. Worst investment I have ever made on a vehicle. Also, the onboard car’s computer is absolutely faulty too. An absolute “LEMON.” The car’s computer cannot tell the difference between an actual road hazard and an anomaly in the vicinity of the car, including speed limits signage’s. Worst overall investment I have ever made and serious buyers’ remorse. The End!!

reviews.author: NotAHappyCamper83
reviews.review_text: Do not trust the recurring payment option. The app updated and it canceled all of my recurring payments, causing me to be a few days past due, and when I panicked and hit “pay now” it automatically made me pay for the past due bill as well as the next month’s payment. Thankfully paying two payments at once didn’t wreck my finances for the month, so I just set the recurring payments back up, triple checked everything, and the very next time I had to make a payment, the exact same thing happened. At the risk of being dramatic, my credit score could plummet because of this, and my car could ultimately get repossessed. I have never in my life been so much as one day late with any payment, and I’ve been late twice because I trusted this app. Never again will I trust this app to actually go through with recurring payments the way it’s supposed to.

reviews.author: Antgon16
reviews.review_text: Love Toyota but seems like they’re lacking the basic foundation of what makes an app that takes payment truly an app that makes you feel supportive in the process. Through the COVID-19 Pandemic the app offers a Payment Relief which directs you to the website. This made me realize. If you look at the mobile website versus the app; the mobile website has more tool bar features such a “support center”. This blows my mind. Something so simple not available in the app. If the user needs support, they need to go to the site. Now get this... the support center on the site doesn’t let you even properly generate tickets in the drop down. It’s as if they forced you to call them. All in all, the most basic feature that should be on the app for me at least makes me rate this app one star. Toyota, you guys need to step up your app game. Almost every review is sharing the same thing; poor quality

reviews.author: Cyber Slider
reviews.review_text: I had to reset my password because I was not being logged in. I used the same info that I tried to login in with the first time because it wasn’t working and I thought I would set it right. The system would not allow because it said my new password is the same as my old password. That is a ridiculous waste of my time. Why did it not log me in in the first place? I tried multiple times with the pass I had on record. Unnecessarily difficult. I will complain about other inconveniences on the phone, personally to an operator when I have time. No more to waste here

reviews.author: Rmags24
reviews.review_text: First few months I had no issue making my payments, everything was dandy. Then they got an update and my payments were being returned. I had to open a new account because it was not taking it from the account I had initially set up. I always pay on time and try to stay ahead. I receive my September statement and it shows a lower outstanding balance then what the app is showing. After being on the phone for over an hour, they cannot figure out why it shows that. They show a larger balance and cannot even pull up my statement and tell me that I am probably one of the many people that don’t know how to use the app. They tell me that a manager will call within 24-48 hours and I don’t receive a call. I call back and they still can’t help me out. I love Toyota but I will NOT be financing anymore vehicles with Toyota Financial.

reviews.author: AngelG01
reviews.review_text: What is up with this new update on the app?? The login consent was a bunch of crap before but now it’s even worse I dont know what you guys were thinking and you are definitely going to loose a bunch of people with this. The consent agreements were long before and you had to accept every time you logged in now they’re even longer and you can’t even access the app. I haven’t been able to access the app I keep agreeing with the consent forms and all it does is refresh them and keep me in the same login screen. I don’t understand why it’s mandatory to keep agreeing to these same things EVERY single time you try to login what’s the point? I make my payments and other things through this app and now I can’t even access it because of this. This new update and consent agreement features are going to be the death of this app and trust me there are many people that hate these same things

reviews.author: Anonymous App User.
reviews.review_text: If you read reviews from 1 year ago they posted how they got charged twice. Come my time to use this app and it happened to me. Don’t set up auto pay on the website nor on the app it doesn’t connect you account which is the dumb thing I’ve ever heard. So I had $900 come out when I don’t have that luxury made me negative in my bank account. As well they have the worst return policy they mail you a check that they say takes 10 business day I’m on day 15. The customer service isn’t 24/7. Plus the customer service team belittles when you call. Worst service and experience I will pay my car and pray to god I don’t have to use them ever again. I’ll get my money by the next payment. I will get more fees on my bank thanks to stupid app/website not connecting your account or them addressing that.

reviews.author: Beautiful Hokkaido
reviews.review_text: I like that Toyota has their own app to make your payments but a couple of months ago I used the app like I normally do and he gave me a confirmation number and everything turns out the next month I get a notification on my credit port saying that I missed a payment for Toyota financing dropped my score 30 points I was so mad cause I didn’t miss the payment luckily I had the confirmation number and created a dispute with my credit report show the proof that I paid it days before the due date it took another month for my score to go up those 30 points.

reviews.author: Servian Wall
reviews.review_text: The app is cleaner and moves faster than the Toyota app, which is nice. I find it annoying how they have the Privacy Choices and Performance Tracking set up. For Privacy Choices, it doesn’t tell you whether the default is allowing or disallowing the sharing of your information, and there’s no indication on the toggle. The website leads me to believe they are defaulted to off, and I can only assume then that the toggle color being gray means it is off. The app seems to remember all my settings except for in Performance Tracking. And these settings also don’t have clear indications as to whether the default is allowing or disallowing the tracking, and no indication on the toggles. Every time I open the app the toggles for allowing that tracking are set so that they are red, presumably allowing. I can turn them off, but they will reset when I reopen the app. There is an option to Anonymize Personal Data, but it appears to default to off and will not remember if I change it. When everything else works properly and is labeled well, these two problems come across as intentionally vague and sleazy.

reviews.author: Christian Cagigal
reviews.review_title: Bad user design, not good for all phones
reviews.review_text: I have an iPhone SE 2020. It’s not an old phone at all. But the formatting of the buttons and information on the app are all designed for longer phones so sometimes I literally can’t do things on the app because they’re cut off at the bottom and I can’t swipe them up either. I can’t pay, I can’t edit, I change, I can’t schedule. This wasn’t a problem a year ago and was always happy with the app. But some bad changes were made recently and for a few months it’s been hard to actually pay Toyota financial, and it’s the app design’s fault. Please fix.

reviews.author: Condor girl
reviews.review_title: Love the app but today I had an issue
reviews.review_text: I have been using the app with ease since purchasing my new car and LOVE how easy it is to navigate. Today however I had trouble scrolling down far enough to see where to swipe to pay because of the new look. After reinstalling and checking for updates, I still couldn’t make my payment because it wouldn’t let me scroll down to see where to swipe for payment. I had to go on another device to make my payment. I hope this is fixed before next month so I can pay from the app like before. It was so much easier.

reviews.author: Manojan786
reviews.review_text: All are very nonprofessional specially Managers ID # 1JPE Jerry , is not ready to listen, they make mess at their end and put their mess to innocent customer like me who pay his instalments before due day with extra money with neat and clean record from last more then 3 years with Toyota financial services but some of non professional lose and destroy the credibility of this Toyota institute and now I am facing hardship tension and frustration because of nonprofessional people, if some one professionally inquires my case he or she definitely make a strictly dispensary action against those who make this mess and punish them as per their SOP 😡

reviews.author: Marilyn Yvette
reviews.review_title: Hard to login every single time.
reviews.review_text: Anytime I try to login whether it’s with my Apple ID fingerprint or username/password, a pop up message comes on saying that they’re having technical difficulties on their end and to please try again later. That happens too often in the app and some things are time sensitive where I can’t wait later to try again, only to get the same pop up message when I wait hours or even days. Once I finally get to login, which is after multiple attempts on different days, then it works good. I’m able to use it as intended, however, it’s still so frustrating trying to get into the app. Please fix this issue, I don’t understand why it makes it so difficult to do something so simple as just logging in.

reviews.author: Alfisch
reviews.review_text: Straight forward, succinct, not 352 pages of disclaimers before you get to the meat of the program. I went there today to set up the recurring payment schedule and everything I needed was within the first page of two. Actually, that is as far as I got because it was so easy and user friendly. It will take me longer to write this review than it did to set up and confirm the payment schedule - and I’m fine with that! (Pro-Tip: I anticipated needing the routing and account # for the payment to be withdrawn from before I opened the application so I had that ready to go.)

reviews.author: ChristBeard
reviews.review_text: I bought a toyota last year in July. The app then was ok. It worked but the UI wasn't the strongest and it had some weird login tendencies and other issues. But overall it worked fine. With the changes they've made in the last month or two, its like a new app. Very intuitive, easier to pay, easier to track, etc. they made some very welcome changes and put a-lot of thought into their now new app. I would have given it 5 stars before but it wasn't a “leave a review 5 stars worthy” type of app in my opinion . Well now it is.

reviews.author: CEG115
reviews.review_text: I switched banks and used the app to set up the new bank for autopay. On the app, my old bank account is gone and my new bank is loaded and I’m thinking, “okay cool we’re set.” NOPE! TFS still took payment from my old account before I could close it and over-drafted the account. Although the app has all my current information, it did not sync with the desktop site and still has my old bank information. So I had to also update the website to make sure all future payments come from the correct account. You might as well use the desk top site for your TFS needs since the app doesn’t actually work. I have never had this issue with any other app so please figure this app out. You are a major car manufacturer and can afford a department for app development and maintenance. This was very annoying and inconvenient.

reviews.author: kindshowaxkxi
reviews.review_text: I pay my bill ON THE DATE it is due every month. When I did this for September it accepted the payment, it usually takes up to a week for the payment to go through so I waited. It’s been 2 weeks and when I saw that the money was still in my account and the app was not letting me log in. I had to call them and they said my account had insufficient funds which is a lie because my account always has 2-3x more than what I need for my bills. The fact that no one called me about a late payment is insane I could’ve had my car repod for no reason and been left without a car. They took off the late payment and I finally got the money taken out of my account. This is ridiculous that I have to make something happen when it’s Toyotas responsibility to want to make some money.

reviews.author: gflkjhgfdaqe2468
reviews.review_text: I have been using this App for over 3 years with every update it gets worse than before, every time you update this app, all your personal preferences such as Touch ID, security questions and a bunch of other annoying settings will be deleted and you have to start fresh and also the developers change the entire layout of this app with every update and that’s never been better than before and poor you the user have to get used to the new scattered dashboard etc, another annoying thing with Toyota financial is that they fetch bunch of terms and agreements via this app that you have to agree every month or so and that always comes with each update, I use more than 30 big banks and brokerages app this App by far the worst app, probably couple of 7th grade middle school kids are the developers!

reviews.author: macouertoujours
reviews.review_text: As a TFS user, when I bought my car from an authorized Toyota dealer in the KC area in 2023, they let me know I’d have the ease of an app to make payments, get a payoff quote if I ever got to pay the car note off early, easy customer service and support and more! You can pay a custom amount weekly if you wanted for your loan or all at once on the due date! You can set up auto payments or pay as you go! Love that type of ease for those who are living paycheck to paycheck, breaking down payments weekly helps! By far the easiest and best car financing option I’ve ever had!

reviews.author: ryanjiverson
reviews.review_text: The recently updated app is terrible. I usually make my payments a week early but it was declined. I tried to make my payment again after the due date and it was declined again. I tried again for a third time yesterday but my payment was due on 7/26. I am absolutely never late on any payment on anything and I’m incredibly disappointed. Don’t bother calling support either, you will wait on hold for over 30 minutes just to hear they’re working on it. I’m expecting leniency and an apology to all of the people having the same issue with the updated app but the apparent lack of concern and communication on their behalf is also frustrating. I have financed my last two vehicles through Toyota but, due to this experience, I will probably go with another option on the next round.

reviews.author: LUVTHAWEB
reviews.review_text: Do you people think about the people more likely to buy a vehicle snd use this app?? I used it since I bought the vehicle snd you could actually see the date, the vehicle, the payment amount, everything on the page to pay it!! But NOW, someone probably someone with a college degree, BUT NO COMMON SENSE decides to update the app and make all the amounts snd dates, and info almost all invisible!!! Could you possibly think of the older people in the world for once!! Because WE BUY YOUR CARS MOST OF THE TIME!!! Thank you for making one more thing more difficult!! MAUREEN Ferrara 65 years old.

reviews.author: Mafootabagoncher
reviews.review_text: The Toyota automated service does everything except let me speak to a representative. I called back over and over again thinking I’d missed something. I finally spoke to a representative after the automated system gave me tons of useless information and told me to hang up. At that point I asked to speak to a representative and was put on hold for the next available one. The process wasted thirty minutes of my day. When I did speak to a representative, she was very helpful and resolved all the issues that I needed resolved.

reviews.author: Luigi702
reviews.review_text: I’ve been using TFS app for over two years now and in this last updated I came across many issues. For one the processing in between screens was very slow. And also had to tried many times to submit my payment because system would say “something went wrong try again” took me a while before I could actually get the payment to process. At one point the app instructed me to call customer service. Anyway very annoying when something has been working just fine and they decide to make changes to it. Which would be nice if the changes were to actually make the app functionality better. But not the other way around. I hope multimillion dollar company as Toyota and its affiliates would look into this problem.

reviews.author: Tom Hale
reviews.review_text: While there are some nice features in the app (Face ID login, ability to see your payment history and statements, remaining payments/payoff amounts), there are always a few bugs making this app the most frustrating financial app on my phone. A recent update deleted all my bank account information making me re-enter the info even though it had been saved prior. Trying to set up recurring payments? Sorry the confirm slide bar was designed too low on the page so you end up swiping out of the app instead of completing the process. The alternative is completing the paper forms which can be mailed to you and mailing it back, no thanks.

reviews.author: Macgyvie
reviews.review_title: App doesn’t work with smaller phones
reviews.review_text: I had this all and it worked great until I updated it. Now I can’t use it to pay my car payment. When you try to pay and it asks for what date you want to select, you can’t get passes this screen. I tried the app on mh girlfriend’s iPhone 13 pro max which has a bigger screen. On her phone there is a continue button you need to press on the bottom of her screen. The problem is on an iPhone 7 Plus, that continue button is no where to be found. You can’t scroll the screen to access it either, so you are essentially stuck. Please fix this for people who don’t have the big screens

reviews.author: Foxtail Moxtail
reviews.review_text: The app use to be very simple and user friendly. The update they made has caused this to become one of the most frustrating apps I have. On the app I can no longer access statements, update/remove bank accounts, seamlessly view payments. I attempted to go to the desktop to update my recurring payment and it’s says it must be done from the platform used to complete the set up. Meaning the mobile app. There are so many things wrong with the app, I can’t understand why Toyota would proceed with the release of it. The inconvenience of this app makes me want to just leave all together!

reviews.author: Myktron
reviews.review_title: It’s like they want you to mess up
reviews.review_text: This app sets you up for failure. It’s had bugs since I purchased with them. For 6months it would tell me my password was incorrect and had to make a new one each month. Then my payment didn’t go thru last month because the date was automatically placed for next month instead of that day(which I take partial blame for, should have verified) but why the fkuc was it automatically set for the next month in the first place!?Now it’s not letting me make a payment, I choose the date & amount and then there’s not even a slide or button to complete the payment.. it’s like ok what now? Restarted the app multiple times.. atleast now I don’t have to create a new password every time I try to log in… worst payment process of all my bills.

reviews.author: 5 by the lake
reviews.review_text: The newest version of this app needs some improvements. The opening pop up screen tries to get me to add vehicles to my finance account that I either no longer own, or paid off long ago. There is no way to disable the pop up. The “recent transactions” field on the homepage lists only 1 failed payment I tried to make through the app, no actual transactions are listed. The “transactions” tab again only lists the failed transaction. There are features of the app I do like: next payment information (due date, amount, number of payments remaining) is listed on the homepage, and all billing statements are available. With some changes, it should be great.

reviews.author: No slew
reviews.review_text: The app worked great until I updated. Then it became a struggle. I had to go through all the security steps again. Then it asked what method I wanted to receive the codes. I chose text and it was emailed to me, I entered it and then it texted me another. Entered it and then it ask for more security options and then the app locked up and would not allow me to select anything so I went back and did it over again and finally after 30 mins I was able to make my online payment. May go back to using the mail. Gee!

reviews.author: Reiskameraad
reviews.review_text: I am in the middle of reading the policies about online tracking and cookies when I am notified that my session is about to expire due to inactivity (I have been consistently scrolling and reading this whole time!). Then, despite clicking the provided red “I’m back” button, I am immediately logged out! This is almost exactly what happens when I use the website as well. Links to payment and reviewing payment history or support, instead log me out of the site. Trying to change an address or personal information sent me to an inactive support page. I am shocked that such a large multinational corporation puts out such garbage of an app and website… Btw, the site admits to using invisible gifs and cookies to track and see unrelated pages as activities of you visit online.

reviews.author: Zay520
reviews.review_title: It should be illegal how bad this app is
reviews.review_text: Every single time the app has an update it logs me out and it takes legit weeks to log back in every single time. It signs me out and won’t take my password then won’t let me change my password or let me log in and pay through the regular Toyota app. This has made me miss payments before which is unbelievably frustrating. Then what’s even worse is you try to call them to fix the problem and only get robots that don’t help fix your problems whatsoever, I even paid through the call service one time then was finally able to login weeks later to find out the payment didn’t even get put only my monthly payments, so great missed that payment too. Currently logged out for the third time.

reviews.author: LawKate671
reviews.review_text: Yup it looks prettier but it functions worse! So this app is garbage! I can’t get it to set up reoccurring payments and when I attempt to choose a day to pay the app brings up a calendar or more accurately part of a calendar. Also after the last update the app defaulted back to a deleted account after 2 successful transactions. This almost over-drafted this account because as I was attempting to close it out had very little balance. When I called to complain the person on the other line suggested I log in on the actual online site. Really it’s my fault for using YOUR app to pay on time?!?! This app and subsequent customer service interaction leave much to be desired. So very glad I have a great interest rate and the dealership is amazing to work with!!

reviews.author: Aye Fite
reviews.review_text: With the newest update (June 2021) it seems that the payment option doesn’t actually let you pay? When you hit the “Pay Now” button it takes you to a screen that lets you select your bank account, date of payment, and payment amount, but after you’ve selected all of those there’s no button to continue… The only interactive button on that payment screen is an “X” in the upper right corner, which obviously closes out the payment screen and takes you back to the home page. Not sure if this was a mistake on the app developer’s end or what, but the app is pretty pointless now aside from being able to check your bill on the go, but not actually be able to pay it…

reviews.author: itunenamethingy
reviews.review_text: I like the ability to pay little by little multiple times in a month, makes budgeting way easier and helped me pay off my car faster! If it wasn’t for this app, and the visual chart of how paid off your car is, it would be a lot harder and less rewarding. But because you can see the bar move when you do big payments, it’s nice seeing that some big huge purchase is way easier to pay for and will be paid for way sooner than I thought all due to this app.

reviews.author: Ka'Nuinui
reviews.review_text: I have been wrongfully charged never in all my time have I been neglectful in payment.I still had the same account from lease and from refinancing have sent me back due to not checking the account I did not change my account your company did upon opening the app same car now there is an an account it has been Sorlie frustrating not to have a human to do business with to correct this mistake this is a negligence on your part I have been trying to contact you for over a month I work I don’t have time to stop takeout hours to chase for help that extra money I put in to the lease need to be transferred to the new finance on the same car and the lease needs to be closed you can’t take my money that doesn’t belong to you.

reviews.author: kanai2009
reviews.review_text: I was told if o called 10 days or more ahead of time I could schedule my payment to be the same as my previous schedule - the 12th of every month. Now I need to mail In paperwork and do soo much more than the last time I did that with my last purchase. I still have yet to receive the promised emailed paperwork to change my payment date - so I will just pay “early” each month because I spent over 30 minutes on hold to be told to finish and mail back paperwork. I get it’s busy and short staffed - I work in the medical profession in a hospital and I get it - changing my payment date shouldn’t take soo much of my life and one day off to make sure it happens - not helpful at all.

reviews.author: KiPatts
reviews.review_text: Ever since the new update, the app has gotten so much better! It moves so much smoother. The slider works the first try. I was finally able to add a phone number to my personal information, put in a different amount to pay towards my loan without having to call. The right corner where a picture of my car is actually showing my vehicle, rather than a stock photo! The app doesn’t crash anymore… I really appreciate the app developers who finally made this app worth having on my iPhone.

reviews.author: critical_criticism
reviews.review_text: I’ve been using this app for about 6 years now . Overall it’s a good app that does it job of allowing me to see my account on my car and paying the bills. But the only thing I have an issue with is that every time they run an update on the app and redesign the whole concept . Which happens every few months. I always get kicked out of my account for whatever reason. And sometimes trying to get back in is a hassle because if you don’t have that stuff memorized, it’s starts asking for account details. Which honestly if your on the go it’s not convenient. I just hope it’s due to a security issue , not a glitch that they keep having to do every update.

reviews.author: neirnrjornrnen
reviews.review_text: The new app update is horrible. I’ve had several months in a row now where the app doesn’t process my payments and they end up late. I’ll have the confirmation information and look at the app and then it says pending for several weeks out! Toyota financial also won’t help you even with the confirmation and hit you with late fees and say it’s on you. But want to charge you to pay over the phone and recommend using the app. I love my car however, will never finance in house ever again. Wells Fargo has better customer service than this company and will be refinancing out of TFS ASAP. TFS is just another company trying to con you into paying more and more fees and only worry about their bottom dollar and not helping customers.

reviews.author: serinaortix
reviews.review_text: The app that was updated is giving wrong information to other accounts it took payments from another account that I have open with my daughter it gives other information about other vehicles that I don’t own anymore. I’ve made payments and for some reason they keep getting canceled with no explanation now I’m behide because it won’t except payments I have to keep checking to make sure it actually goes through. Very frustrating!

reviews.author: carterg827
reviews.review_text: The app as a whole is great. The only issue is when you just close the app normally and don’t close the app in the background by swiping up and out. The next time you open the app, it brings you to a sign in screen without face ID as an option. You either have to sign in manually or swipe up and out and then you can use face ID when you open the app. I know this is nitpicky, but no other app does this. They just request face ID automatically, even if you leave the app and come back without swiping up and out. Thank you for your time.

reviews.author: Phtogrfr
reviews.review_text: I honestly dread having to make my Toyota payment and that’s not because of the balance due. It’s because how awful this app truly is. I have never experience more inconvenience in my entire life paying a bill than trying to use this app. It’s not one particular thing either. For a while It wouldn’t let me scroll down low enough to reach the payment slider. And now as of lately when I go to make a payment it requires to select a date. When I do that, nothing happens. It highlights like I selected a date but doesn’t allow me to advance. So when I naturally hit the back button it doesn’t save my selection. I just don’t understand why it’s so hard to create an app and just pay your bill.

reviews.author: Nashi Gamer
reviews.review_text: I used to just call to make my payments and it was soo time consuming and sometimes frustrating. I didn’t know there was an app at all; then I found out there was and everything was soo much more convenient. However when signing back in it told me my device wasn’t recognizable and it asked for verification through email, text, or call I clicked either one of these and app won’t let me in a “Be back soon” shows up and it’s just frustrating all over again….and this was after the update… so back to calling on the phone with the very long talking robot…

reviews.author: james b b
reviews.review_text: The newest version of this app is absolutely terrible. First off it kicked out all of my information because I had it set to face recognition so I had to go in and set up my account all over again. It is not easy to navigate. I used to be able to find payment history of when I made my last payment. Then when I went to make a payment it gave me an error. And I couldn’t find any customer service number to call to make my payment except one that is closed. I will try in hopes that there is an automated system because I don’t want a late fee. Why is this app moving backwards?

reviews.author: Vertix Scribe
reviews.review_title: Updated UI great for 10, 11, 12, but not 7/8/SE2020
reviews.review_text: Hopefully they’ll fix this in a future update, but sometimes you can’t scroll down far enough or tap/swipe certain buttons as easily (like the “Swipe to Pay” function on the payment screen). I mean yes, it “works” but it is not currently optimized for the 2020 iPhone SE, and I would assume the same for the 7/8 since it is the same size screen. I’m sure this app looks fantastic on a longer screen like the X/XR/11/12. I’d rather have the SE for the added security features (Touch ID vs Face ID) so I’m likely never going to buy a 12.

reviews.author: Sheldons choices
reviews.review_text: Are use an iPhone for this app after the recent update for the app I seem to no longer be able to make a payment using the app please advise Another update ….. using the iPhone12 app is still glitchy. I am unable to make a pmnt as the buttons are too close to bottom of screen. When I try to “swipe” the pmnt button the entire screen moves. I cannot search the calendar to change a pmnt date either. The 1 wk that is shown is all I can see. I can’t move, slide or choose a different date it seems. I’ll have to use the website again this month to make my pmnt. Please fix 😀

reviews.author: Davees36
reviews.review_title: Stay away from Toyota financial services company
reviews.review_text: If you don't want to see your credit score drop down for no reason so Just stay away from this scam company... They love to report everything to your credit score companies... Today after I made my payment on time they hit my credit history with -45 point because they reported a late fees on my account so go shop somewhere else for car loan stay away from this scam company called Toyota financial services.. I've warned you...

reviews.author: EMC Erin
reviews.review_text: I’ve had to call multiple times because when I update my information, it says something different than what it says on customer services end. They told me to remove the information for my bank account to skip my test payments due to COVID; however, when I did that, it continued to take money out of my account when I added it back in to the app, it took out a payment immediately instead of doing the recurring payments on the due date. When I called customer service, they said they did not see it on a recurring payment after I had just input the information into the app. The app is not very user friendly and not working properly. Please fix this app.

reviews.author: Bigdadd10
reviews.review_text: The app is nice and convenient but I get tired of having to update the app EVERY month when I pay my bill!! It kind of defeats the purpose of having an app that is convenient for paying your bill...!! Update Sept 10th. The last update works very well!! The finger print option was very convenient and the pay options were very fast. Working good... so STOP UPDATING!! The app is working... May 5th. Another update and another plea to STOP UPDATING THE FREAKING APP!!!!!!! EVERY MONTH I have to update the app before I can pay my bill. How much functionality do you need this app to do??!!!! All I use it for is to pay my bill... you need to find something else for this person to do because it is obvious that they are bored and have nothing else to do... it’s absolutely annoying.

reviews.author: Sintek84
reviews.review_text: In the two years I’ve had this app I’ve had to restart my password multiple times a month because the system never remembers who I am. even trying to restart my password the app constantly crashes and doesn’t allow me to type any kind of letters or numbers. this app is trash. years and I’ve changed my password multiple times a month ever since because the system is constantly broken. Fix this garbage app already.

reviews.author: Neeshalove
reviews.review_text: I made a payment the next day the money was not taken out and the schedule payment was no longer there as proceeding or processed. I made another payment like a fool and now I have two payments coming out of my account. Called customer service which was no help because the can’t cancel the payment they can only refund me my money. I don’t even have enough money in my account for both payments because I have other bills coming out at the same time. Now I will be charged overdraft fees and probably late fees from my other accounts. This app is crap and I will never use it again and also thinking about if I will ever deal with Toyota financial services after this car.

reviews.author: Mary3925
reviews.review_title: Something is wrong on our end
reviews.review_text: The first month I got this app it was fine. Now every time I login it says something wrong on our end. Well it’s been like that for four days now. Thankfully I was able to make my payment before it went down for the second month but how am I suppose to make the next payment when your app doesn’t work? Like do they not want people to make payments? Fix your app. Your a large financial institution and it’s embarrassing that your app is this bad and I’ve seen several of the same comments. Messing with someone’s financial payments by having a crappy app is just not cool. Also, going online is just as glitchy so anytime I try to make a payment it’s just frustrating.

reviews.author: _Ris_
reviews.review_text: This app gives me more issues than any app I’ve ever used. I’ve never been one to have issues with passwords but even with the correct password this app often tells me it’s wrong and I have to reset my password every 2-3 times logging in. Yes, I screenshot my passwords for this app as to insure I get it right, it doesn't matter. Now I’m currently trying to log into the app to update my debit card, the app will not allow me to put in my ssn for the account recover and password reset. I type the numbers in for nothing to appear. When I am able to log it, it always verifies with a text message. I have to request for that text message 2-4 times before it actually comes though on my phone.

reviews.author: MrCarpenter24
reviews.review_text: Not only are all of my prior billing statements gone but logging in is a pain as the cursor sometimes moves around. All the wonderful tools that were once there are gonna as well. The new app is jittery too. The whole revamp here just seems counter intuitive. Recent Edit: Still not too great. I don't have access to any of my documents like recent payments, upcoming payments, lease details, etc. It just says there aren't any yet, which isn't true because the desktop site provides me with ample access to these resources.

reviews.author: DJPPSP2003
reviews.review_title: Payment screen red swipe missing iPhone 12
reviews.review_text: The red “make payment” swipe is visible on my iPhone 6S, however, not visible on my iPhone 12. So I went into my display and brightness settings, and made my font, or text size smaller. And now I see the red “make payment” swipe at the bottom of the screen. Hope you figure it out. Also I use the app monthly, and my money goes to Toyota financial every month without any other issues. So I am giving a 5 star. Thank you

reviews.author: yozeda
reviews.review_text: I’ve been very disappointed that Toyota Financial makes it almost impossible to process a Principle Payment in my account. I’ve tried various times & even go to a separate website ,which happens to be very inconvenient! My goal is to pay off my loan earlier thus of course, Toyota makes less money off of interest but it should be done if I choose to handle my finances the best way that’s beneficial to me. I wish that the company could move the additional amount to the principal balance.. I would think again before purchasing a vehicle with Toyota in the future.

reviews.author: fabi wassabi
reviews.review_text: I was under the impression that money was automatically being deducted from my account to pay my car, when I wanted to see and check the app was either “under maintenance” or had an error with services with biometrics. This would happen once and a while but which is fine. But now it never lets me log in finally when fed up months later I log in online outside of the app just to find that nothing has been getting paid nor deducted and I have fallen into extreme debt with my car. There’s no wonder these banks have been calling me. I’m extremely frustrated, upset and angry with Toyotas all developers and lack of communication with customers on how to pay.

reviews.author: RosieGreg
reviews.review_text: I have been encountering several issues with Toyota Financial services app and the customer service representatives. My payments keep showing past due even though I have made several calls to have the errors fixed. It seems like instead of fixing the problem they are being ignored or mistakes are being made by the representatives, this includes the supervisor I spoke with previously. The payment issues are not being resolved quickly enough. I am now getting charged late fees when your representatives are the ones making errors on my account to begin with. I am having to pay the price not only the late fees, but also on our credit

reviews.author: Johnnie99999
reviews.review_title: Version 3.x Missing Some Features that 2.x had
reviews.review_text: I should preface this with the fact that I was unable to find a better way to provide app feedback. The “App Support” link on the app’s App Store page just goes to Toyota Financial’s homepage, and the same with the Help and Support function within the app itself. In version 2.x, I could easily see how my previous payments were applied with respect to principal and interest. That seems to be gone in 3.x. In fact, I cant see any of my previous transactions at all. While 3.x has a slicker look and feel, I feel like 2.x was more useful than 3.x.

reviews.author: cottonchopper
reviews.review_title: New version is a step back
reviews.review_text: The new version is such a poor excuse for an app update. There are so many issues with it, like continually needing to log in, unable to see existing or in progress payments, no breakdown of payment history other than statements, can’t get details of multiple payments made in a single payment period, not able to schedule payments that fall on the fifth week in the calendar. These are simple things that should never be allowed from an app that you are trusting to manage and access your money. Sorely needs updating and can’t wait until my vehicle is paid off so I can delete this poor excuse of a financial service app and never use again.

reviews.author: Catalina meow
reviews.review_text: I’ve had my Toyota Tacoma for 2 1/2 years now I made my first three payments through the app and everything was fine it saved me a ton of time but for the last 2+ years I have been unable to use the app I have called customer service and they said only about a third of the people are able to use the app so it’s not very helpful if you’re not able to use it You would think $1 billion company that says they are all about customer service would have a better app

reviews.author: Dimps53
reviews.review_text: You can’t put in the date that you want to pay on! You can’t reach anyone unless they call you! It takes to long for the money to be taken! If I’m trying to pay on a certain date it’s because I will have the funds in my account. Don’t wait two or three days after to withdraw the money it might not be there at that time. That why I try to pay it before the due date. The calendar will not let me pick some of the dates.

reviews.author: Anhc1
reviews.review_title: Received letter today incorrectly stating my loan is paid!
reviews.review_text: I have no idea what’s happened to receive a letter that my loan was paid and this app erased all my automatic payment information after 3 years. I still owe quite a bit so as customer service is of course closed the day this happens, will renter everything hoping to rectify whatever happened. Had never missed a payment. It may be last month something happened but received no notification. The money was in my account so nothing explains this. Esrpecily the part that the loan has been paid off!

reviews.author: kaitlyn444444
reviews.review_text: I have never had a problem making a payment until the update. I made a payment, received a confirmation and even an email stating that the payment went through and applied to my balance. However, I noticed the money was never taken out and I check that the money was removed from my balance. Please fix, I shouldn’t have to use a computer or call to make a payment.

reviews.author: Aquaticsmurf
reviews.review_text: Trying to make my first car payment after buying a new car and every time I attempt to add a payment method the app glitches out. The moment I enter either my routing number or account number for my bank I can’t do anything on the screen other the edit other text boxes. The app doesn’t even process that the text boxes are filled presenting me with the option to move forward. Even the back button does nothing and external links do nothing, I just have to close the app and try again but continually to no avail. Sure I can call or go in person to pay my bill but that defeats the entire purpose of this app…

reviews.author: What the heEeEeeeLL
reviews.review_title: I tried this cuz the website’s links are broken
reviews.review_text: The whole reason I got the app was because several links on the dashboard of the website took me to an error message (including the support/customer service link). I tried it on someone else’s laptop as well since my OS is so old and it still gave me error messages. This app does not have any sort of way to contact customer service, either via email or live chat or some kind of messaging system. That was the whole reason I downloaded it! I was trying to avoid calling anyone as I just had a baby and it’s obviously a huge interruption at any given time. And of course she started crying after my 30 minutes of waiting for a rep to answer my call.

reviews.author: Echoman1421
reviews.review_text: Love my 2018 platinum Toyota Tundra. I do Uber/Lyft in it and every single person is blown away when they enter the back. I push the front passenger seat all the way forward. I had a passenger 6’9” tall cross his leg and even stretched them all the way out! I also have monitor on the headrest which mirrors off my phone so the customers can see their ride experience live. Thank you Toyota for making long lasting vehicles! Oh sorry the app is also awesome!

reviews.author: seancnh2
reviews.review_text: After calls to customer service and hoping to hear back from a customer service representative for a solution, I have officially given up on trying to continue using this app as it doesn’t work properly. Constant issues which in turn, causes issues with my payments not being on time when they indeed should. There’s always an “error” message or “loading” and nothing ever pops up. The app also will not allow me to update ANY of my personal information. Certainly not convenient and no one has yet to respond to these complaints. I never received assistance. Therefore, I will no longer be using this service.

reviews.author: Ath17177
reviews.review_text: Literally before this newest update this app was GARBAGE. And was horrible to use (I had to sign the agreement every time I opened the app which was super annoying and it was just overall underwhelming). Now it has a fresh modern look, can use Face ID (thank god) and I can happily pay my bills without scrolling through five hundred pages of stuff I’ve already agreed to a thousand times. If I have any issues with it I’ll update this review but first impressions are a MASSIVE step forward from what I’ve been dealing with for the past year. Thank you for updating!

reviews.author: MayaPula
reviews.review_text: I suspect that the same thing has that has happened to others happened to me because of a faulty app. I made a payment earlier this month using the app for the first time and it’s a good thing I checked my account today because apparently there was a “Payment Reversal” four days later but posted for the same date I made the payment. No explanation, no notice. So now I owe backpay and the next month payment. The website shows I made the payment and that it’s approved, but that I still owe the backpay. I actually made another payment using the app today, but then immediately cancelled it—I’m really hoping that works—and then used the website instead. I’m too wary to to use the app anymore.

reviews.author: Mano2480
reviews.review_text: This app used to work just fine back when I first purchased my truck in February. Since then there have been multiple updates which erase my recurring payment setups and make it difficult to reassign recurring payments. Now, every month, I have to log-in before the payment is supposed to post, check to see what upcoming transactions are scheduled (which apparently never save), update the app, again, make a one-time payment and attempt to setup my payment schedule, AGAIN. So, thank you for taking something that should be so simple to use and making it a frustrating and cumbersome monthly interaction. If that was your goal…NAILED IT.

reviews.author: toyotaclient
reviews.review_text: First months payment was a mess! Tried contacting someone over phone and was unable to connect to someone. Had to drive to the Toyota dealership and my financial advisor assisted and even he was frustrated . I was told the those behind this app that I would get a call from IT. Like I suspected I got no call. My account is still not set up because of their glitch that they tried to blame on the Toyota advisor and myself and now I have to go through the struggle all over again this month. Please fix your app as soon as possible . This is really frustrating and though I love my car the complication and glitches in this financial service system is making me look at Toyota in a negative way now .

reviews.author: evertoexcel99
reviews.review_text: The app is easy enough to use but there have been two instances in the past 5 months when my checking account was debited twice when making my monthly payment. In July, I scheduled one payment - but my checking account was charged twice for the same amount. This week, I scheduled one payment - but my checking account was charged twice for the same payment. Both times TFS refunded the duplicate transaction but for it to happen twice is aggravating. Customer service rep this week said to delete the app and download a newer version. I have done that so hoping that solves the issue.

reviews.author: B. Doty
reviews.review_text: Still horrible usage on mobile phone which in the past was normally easier and quicker way for me to make payments . The swipe to pay verbiage is now visible instead of being located at the very bottom portion and unable to access. Thank you! Now please move the red circle to swipe up on the screen where it is visible please!!!!!! It will let you swipe for payment but it’s too low visualize on the screen.

reviews.author: Rene208
reviews.review_title: Unable to log in to my account through the app
reviews.review_text: I don’t know what is wrong with the app and their login system, but I have been unable to log in to my account entirely. I have been entering the correct login info for my account, but then it says that an email has been sent to complete registration despite having made an account 2 weeks ago, aside from that I don’t even receive the supposed email link at all either. The same process happens when I try logging in through the actual website as well. This app is incomprehensibly unusable and practically worthless to me considering I can’t even login to my account whatsoever.

reviews.author: Junito556
reviews.review_text: When I first purchased my Camry which I enjoy very much. I had downloaded this app which worked great and was very easy to make my payments. But as soon as the new update was downloaded I have not been able to make payments through this app which stinks. I’ve had to call in a payment every month since the latest update. Help to fix this problem would be great. Thank you

reviews.author: Chumzy67
reviews.review_text: Unfortunately, I had high hopes for Toyota financial. I figured with their reliable vehicles they would also be a reliable finance company. Wow was I wrong. They denied all covid extensions I needed. My cars got repoed and they threatened to keep my personal belongings. They told the repo yard to not give me my belongings. I had to get the police involved in which the repo yard then allowed me to get my property. Toyota agent kept telling me “I don’t care about what the police says it’s our policy” as if they’re policy is higher than the law. Very sad. I’m only 19 years old by the way and they approved me for 150k worth of auto loans and my Each of my vehicle payments Were over $800 a month. I will never be financing a vehicle again due to my experience

reviews.author: Make a better application
reviews.review_text: I have struggled for the last several hours to get my new vehicle to show up. I tried calling the offices and had to site through several Minutes of prompts which resulted in the offices closing. I’m not sure why my new vehicle didn’t automatically show up. When I called and talked to someone they told me to create a new profile. The whole process was a huge waste of time in order for me to pay my bill. When I tried to create a new account because that’s what I was told to do, I got a message saying there was an error on your end. The app is too busy and difficult to navigate with unnecessary advertisements for Toyota and stimuli.

reviews.author: sierraskylewis
reviews.review_text: I have used this app for about 2 years and it has been so problematic. It doesn’t show updates when your bill is paid. It says failed payment regularly even when it goes through and I panic every time. The phone customer service is fine but a online chat service would be much more convenient. But they can’t really do anything regarding payments. They just tell you to call your bank but your bank can’t do anything so then you have to call and wait for Toyota customer service again. This has happened multiple times otherwise I wouldn’t complain. It’s just a nightmare.

reviews.author: MusicTeacher1
reviews.review_text: When this app first came out, I was thrilled. For some reason, I can no longer make payments through my computer, and no one at FS can help me fix that. The app came out, and I was making payments over the phone easily! Well, for a few months, anyway. Now when I try, I fill in the required information (payment amount, date) but I can’t slide the button to make the payment because it isn’t high enough on the screen for me to see it/touch it. It is below the bottom edge of my phone screen. Please fix this so I can make payments from your app again.

reviews.author: Cptausburn
reviews.review_title: Great app to pay bill online
reviews.review_text: Someone commented that there is constantly an updated needed. I don’t see any excess updates on other apps where I pay bills. And it’s not near as frequent as Fb. I get that seems like e every couple of weeks and it takes Fb a lot longer to update than Toyota. Overall, I love the app. Easy and fast way to pay bills. I can look at pay off, transaction history and more. I think it’s pretty simple and don’t mind any 5sec updates.

reviews.author: lisanguyeners90
reviews.review_text: Before the update I would easily be able to make my car payment which I do ahead in advance by the way and it tell me a confirmation but now it’s saying it’s still processing after a week of me making my monthly payment, it’s also glitching and and looking sketchy it doesn’t show the date I actually made the payment just the date the monthly payment is due and still processing. If this messes up my credit or make me make a double payment it’s gonna be a problem because it shows it was taken out from my bank. Y’all need to fix the new update it’s very inconvenient that I will not be using the app anymore.

reviews.author: Gregory Paul
reviews.review_title: Payoff option has been removed, no iCloud Keychain
reviews.review_text: Two issues with this new update, I hope you guys really are reading the feedback.. 1. Yes we all had to login again, this happens with many apps after updates. However the name/password autofill from iCloud Keychain is not working, it worked before the update, please fix it. 2. The option to request a payoff amount and make that payment has been completely removed. Why? Please put it back. Kindly fix these two issues and I will gladly revise this review with 5 stars.

reviews.author: MetaGal973
reviews.review_text: The Skip month Payment option, unlike difference payment apps for other car companies, does not* mean your loan payment is added an additional Month One time, The app says “paymount amount due next month (after clicking skip) will say the amount you skipped, BUT EXCLUDES, that it will be compounded, so if it was 700, it'll be 1400 now The app is not reliable for deeper information, and that was misleading.

reviews.author: Trash Auto Pay
reviews.review_text: I was signed up for auto pay for MONTHS. And because I was paying more than I needed, the system tells me I’ve paid my car note, confirmed email and all, just to tell me 4 days later that my payment did not go through once I’m paying all my other bills BECAUSE I THOUGHT THE PAYMENT WENT THROUGH. Spoke with customer service and they just don’t know, can’t transfer me to management. Just trash now.

reviews.author: fergus51
reviews.review_text: The app is bad and the website is bad. And this is my first time using but I can tell it’s awful. What huge Corp doesn’t show pending payments?? I paid 2 days ahead of due date. 3 days later amount is withdrawn from my checking acct. and on that day my TFS acct shows past due but looking further payment shows in payment history. Makes NO sense whatsoever! Get it together Toyota! It’s impossible to tell where you stand!

reviews.author: Lovethecarshatetheapp
reviews.review_title: The latest update has been garbage…
reviews.review_text: I’ve had this app on my phone for at least 8 years. Never had one problem. But since the update…I can’t access the full calendar to schedule a payment, the swipe to pay feature doesn’t seem to take into account the “scheduled date” nature of making a payment. My iPhone is only an 8. Surely not too old to work with this app that’s basically been necessary to make on time payments on my vehicles. Very disappointed with the update. The app is basically worthless to me at this point and I have to use the PC to pay my bill.

reviews.author: sgjkbyjj
reviews.review_text: First time using new app. No issues with old app my first payment failed. I called customer service to see why it had failed and they suggested that I inputted the routing or account number in correctly. Totally understand it could have been my fault so when I went to look I couldn’t see what I had entered. I then added a bank account with the correct number. First account name was ABC the second one I named ABC Bank and now both bank accounts say ABC Bank and no way to delete the incorrect bank account. Hope this payment goes through this time and I hope I chose the new one instead of the old one.

reviews.author: DDUNNAWAY
reviews.review_text: Just be aware, the website and the TFS app on your phone are not compatible. Spoke with a representative about duplicate monthly charges for my newly purchased Camry and was told the recurring payment date I implemented with the app was secondary to the one issued on my closing statement. The app had no idea there was already a set date for payment withdrawals. The representative said they could not change the website data. What?! Just curious why they kept telling me via email to set up automatic payments when one was already in place. Now I’m waiting two weeks for a $600 refund. And two payments would have continued to be withdrawn if I hadn’t called. This app needs work.

reviews.author: Israel Mont
reviews.review_text: It’s frustrating that I cannot make my on-time online payment before the due date. My payment is due tomorrow (11/13) and today is 11/12. It’s 2022, post Covid and we still can’t pay on time? Why am I being forced to pay after the due date when I should be able to pay on time since my payment is due tomorrow. This definitely needs to be fixed.

reviews.author: ms goree
reviews.review_text: My issue is I pay on time with the help of ur app but, every time it’s time to make a payment, I have a hard time logging in because your system does not recognize me and no two people can have the same face recognition unless they are twins. I constantly have to answer security questions or something. Security is everything however this is annoying!

reviews.author: KilJoy
reviews.review_text: The app works great most of the time. Unfortunately, I was late in a payment once and when I made the payment, a day after the due date, the payment I thought I was making towards the pass due date was actually scheduled for the next billing date, not the past due date. I didn’t realize this until I got another email telling me I was past due still. This is when I found out the payment I thought I was making was actually scheduled for the next due date. Ugh! Remember to cross your I’s and T’s because this app will not do it for you.

reviews.author: Needstopassmytime.
reviews.review_text: Since the newest update. I am unable to make a payment when I call I am told it is on my end. I have always made a payment on the app never once have I had an issue with making a payment. Now all of a sudden my payment will go through then it will say failed two weeks later. It has messed up my bank account info and I am unable to make a payment with out deleting the account and adding it back in…. So now it’s my fault… WRONG THE APP MESSED IT UP! 32 payments not a single issue… my 33rd payment I can not make! I’ll be mailing in my payments from now on.

reviews.author: App-update
reviews.review_text: I kept trying to pay my bill, but it said there was a problem on their end and to try again later. I was late with my bill because I kept trying and kept forgetting to lay my bill. I needed to update the app but it didn’t say anything like that. It should say that and that it was a problem on my end so I didn’t keep trying over and over again.

reviews.author: ABHAUG
reviews.review_text: I am trying to pay my monthly payment through TFS and it is always threw an error in latest version. Please fix the issue ASAP. The recurring payment were worked last month. I thought of changing the date in recurring payment process and cancel the remaining months. But, there is no option available to reschedule the payment at all.

reviews.author: Billy.50
reviews.review_text: Why can’t you make a payment using just your debit card information. Why do you have to provide bank account information and routing information for one time payments. In my option, that should only have to be submitted for automatic recurring withdrawals that you sign up for monthly when you choose to have the payment set up that way.

reviews.author: sumtin2much
reviews.review_text: I made my auto payment 2 weeks early through the app so that it didn’t get withdrawn on the due date. I called customer service to make sure it wasn’t going to come through and the rep told me it wasn’t going to. It on the due date it still came out of me bank account. Then because I had already made the payment the next payment isn’t due until 2 months later when it should have not come through that month because it was already paid!

reviews.author: Katflet
reviews.review_text: I love the general look and feel of this app - it’s (mostly) easy to use and the information is easy to find, monthly payment scheduling works great. But y’all, if you don’t have a gigantic smartphone, you may find that some of the features are cut off and you can’t scroll down to get to them. I can’t set up recurring payments because the button is below the length of my screen, and some other features aren’t adaptive for users with small(er) mobile phones. As of December 2021, anyway.

reviews.author: Moncho_25
reviews.review_text: The app is horrendous. It crashes all the time when trying to change settings. Right now, it’s stuck on light mode so I can read the stupid thing. The paper-look statement is terrible! To add to the terrible experience, to make principal only payments is not intuitive at all. The bank set up is looped into the process to make principal only payments. After creating or entering the bank info, the user thinks the payment will also be processed. However, that is not the case. The system takes out to the first screen but now it shows the bank and have to enter the principal only payment amount AGAIN. A simple process turned into a confusing nightmare. The bank settings for principal only payments should be separate so the user know is creating that FIRST and then making the payment. The continues to be extremely glitchy. It froze once and crashed twice trying to enter the bank info on the process above:(

reviews.author: Armyofone15d
reviews.review_text: Since the update I’ve had NOTHING BUT ISSUES! I can’t add my new vehicle I just purchased because the keyboard literally just keeps popping up after I enter my VIN. I deleted the app and reinstalled and still couldn’t do it. The log in screen has issues with reset. When I try to enter my SSN the app either doesn’t register my input or is EXTREMELY delayed. Fix this so I can make my payments!

reviews.author: Semperfi4121
reviews.review_text: Whenever I scheduled a payment on the App it affirms the payment. You check back in a couple of days and the payment has failed. Then you find out there was a payment that they say never went through months ago, but they’ve been taking payments every month on time but this payment was never credited to your account? Trash!

reviews.author: Dissatisfied customer 1K
reviews.review_text: Site is constantly crashed and inaccessible then if you modify your payment amount from the total balance or pay in split payments it randomly pays to principal and leaves you with late fees even if you over pay. I have never missed a payment but the balance is always reflecting incorrect and I receive calls where I have to explain to the incompetent staff how to count the payments made since I got the car. Horrible technology and customer service I want to refinance just to get with a better company so I can have proper reporting to my credit agency and less hurdles with poor website and app developers.

reviews.author: hwnaisjsNO
reviews.review_text: Very good update. This app has previously been an opposition against my time and enjoyment. I once spent an hour trying to automate my payments on the app, then on the phone on hold to no avail. The new update is no longer incredibly slow and confusing. Its easy and has those easy on the eyes graphics and my payments are automated and it took 7 seconds. Don’t make any more changes.

reviews.author: Chrissss.ss
reviews.review_text: My Toyota experience has been very easy going… I’m going to be honest here.. I’ve been late for a few months on my payments but Toyota has been understanding and are allowing me to make payments as soon as I possibly can so I thank the for real 🙏🏾… Their customer service is so reliable, they make everything so easy and smooth. They’re some well trained professionals for sure!

reviews.author: DangerRas
reviews.review_text: This is an app you will use once a month to make a car payment. And yet, every single month you have to download the latest update to use the app. So instead of taking 30 sec to make a payment, you have to get on the App Store and wait. Not to mention the security is over the top. The app uses my thumbprint to unlock, yet it still asks for my last four SSN every time I make a payment? Really? Am I worried that some imposter is going to pay off my loan for me? Come on, let’s make this a simple task, not an FBI background check. Dumb it down a little

reviews.author: mfeelngs
reviews.review_text: Oh my gosh the first time I’ve gone on here and it went so smoothly I’m so happy you guys did whatever you did to your app but in any event I made it work smoothly I love it thank you wait Amended: I don’t like how it doesn’t save my login and continually double verify’s me. reviews.author: Coco3256

I made a payment to fix my account to make it current even thought the money is sitting against my principal. Soooo very frustrating and ticked about whole situation!!!!

reviews.author: Eljuanchavo
reviews.review_text: I got payments returned to my bank account multiple times while using the app the only issue was the money was never given back to my account so now I’m missing 2k from my bank account and it’s showing that I am past due on my payments spoke to my bank said no returns were issued from Toyota Financial services I’ve tried speaking to customer support to no avail ….

reviews.author: 2016camry
reviews.review_text: When I first got my car the app was really friendly to use. Simple and to the point. Don’t know why they changed what worked. But I am not impressed with the changes more annoyed with it.

reviews.author: Elisaa19
reviews.review_text: I used to love this app and made it so easy for me to make my payment on time. Ever since they had an update back in July the card on file that I’ve always made a payment with never goes through now until I call. It would be nice if they warned people about this or fixed this. When I called they said I wasn’t the only customer with this issue.

reviews.author: hathompson34
